title: AGO - Problem to PagerDuty (SNOW via classic notification)
description: On Dynatrace Problem open, create PagerDuty only. ServiceNow ITOM events come from Settings → Problem notifications → silvastg (not this workflow).

eventTrigger.filterQuery: event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND event.status == "ACTIVE" AND (event.status_transition == "CREATED" OR event.status_transition == "UPDATED" OR event.status_transition == "REOPENED")

prepare-payload.name: prepare-payload
prepare-payload.description: Map Problem fields to PagerDuty payload (app, severity, runbook).

create-pagerduty-incident.name: create-pagerduty-incident
create-pagerduty-incident.description: Trigger PagerDuty Events API v2. SNOW is classic notification silvastg.
